notes:
The whole quest happens inside your own Mog House, and that is what costs it. 'Mog House' comes back from the resolver as the moghouse SENTINEL rather than a zone id, and 'Moogle' comes back flagged ambiguous -- the 'every Moogle in Vana'diel' shape -- so validate will pair an ambiguous name with a nil zone and demote this to start-only. That is the correct outcome and I have not tried to dodge it by blanking the zone, because blanking it changes nothing and loses the one true fact on the step. In practice the mark would have been harmless, since the only Moogle in a Mog House is yours, but the guard is structural.

Bullets 2 and 3 merge: zoning out and back, then waiting an Earth minute, then talking are one visit to one NPC, and wedging an unmarkable zone-out rung between two talks on the same Moogle would only add noise. The Noble's Bed is carried as an item requirement even though the page says 'place' rather than 'hold' -- installed furniture stays in the inventory, so the runtime's held check is the right proxy; the note says so. Bullet 5 is the outcome (the Mog Safe grows to 80), not a step. Nothing in this quest grants a key item, so there is no evidence anywhere. FLevel 7 is fame in your HOME nation, which varies per character and is why the region is left null rather than guessed.

notes:
Bullet 2 is not a step -- it is the POOL Taillegeas draws from, twenty items of which he asks for 'a few', chosen per run. That cannot go in items (holding one of twenty does not satisfy the trade) and it cannot go in items_alt either, because items_alt means any ONE alternative suffices and here you need several at once. So the trade carries an empty items list with items_partial set and the full pool in the note, which is exactly what items_partial is for. The pool: Chocobo Bedding, Counterfeit Gil, Dart, Eastern Paper, Fernan's Diaries, Goblin Bread, Goblin Doll, Goblin Mushpot, Goblin Pie, Kaiserin Cosmetics, Kongou Inaho, My First Magic Kit, Naphille Pochette, Nyumomo Doll, Shuriken, Silver Obi, Snoll Gelato, Sphene Earring, Tonosama Rice Ball, Turquoise Ring. Steps 1 and 3 are both Taillegeas and consecutive, so they draw as one marker and readiness looks ahead across them. 'Quest Reqs: Mission: Promathia Mission 3-2' is recorded as a prev entry; the Previous field itself is empty.

Bullet 1 sits under a 'Note' heading and is an eight-real-hour cooldown after The Clue, not a step -- and nothing in the packets can see it. Bullet 5 is the reward. It is obtained at step 2 and is not in the header's Reward, so it is legal evidence -- but Popoto is one of the most commonly carried cooking ingredients in the game, and any player who happens to hold one would have the mark jump straight past Valgeir to the hand-in. That is a wrong marker for a real player, so it is left out and the note says why. notes:
Five bullets, five steps, all inside Abyssea - Misareaux, and every one of the four NPCs resolves -- this is about as clean as an Abyssea page gets. The one judgement call is whether the three stranded soldiers are a group. The page does NOT say 'in any order': it gives them as a numbered route by Conflux (#3, #5, #6), and the rule is to read the page rather than to guess at the game, so they stay an ordered ladder. It is flagged, because a search-and-rescue of three scattered NPCs is exactly the shape that usually turns out to be unordered, and if a verifier confirms it they should share a group and draw at once.

Iron Eater's pearlsack is the only observable thing here and it lands on step 1 where it is granted. Mathurin (A) gets no grid because the page gives him none -- only 'Conflux #3' -- and a conflux number is not a grid reference. Iron Eater (A) folds to the same key as the Bastok Iron Eater, so the zone on every step is what keeps them apart.
